task_title: Served /openapi.json is machine-broken: quoted response keys and string-typed enums
task_criteria: AC1: GET /openapi.json (JSONBytes) emits every responses key unquoted — normalised so that all response keys match ^(default|[1-5][0-9]{2})$ and no key retains apostrophes; Python check: python3 -c "import json,sys;d=json.load(sys.stdin);print(sorted(d['paths']['/health']['get']['responses']))" prints ['200']. AC2: every enum in the served spec is a JSON array (components.schemas.QueueEntry.properties.status.enum is a JSON list, not the string '[pending, in_progress, complete, failed]'); AC3: a golden regression test in pkg/api/yaml_test.go fails on a quoted response key or a string-typed enum and passes on the fixed spec. AC4: gofmt -l cmd internal pkg sql prints nothing; go build ./... , go vet ./... , go test ./... -short -count=1 -p 1 and gitreins guard (full Tier 1) all pass.
